title: cascabela thevetioides
intro: Cascabela thevetioides, commonly known as the Yellow Oleander, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antimalarial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glycosides, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cascabela thevetioides, including thevetin, thevetin A, and thevetin B, are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
